navigationLaw: The rescue begins from La Liberacion, crosses a hostile occupied port and reaches the prison-navigation ship physically. The player reads Ethan's route marks in the world; no menu teleport or water fast travel.

actors.name: C08_01_RouteMarkA
actors.title: Ethan's first route mark
actors.body: A Harlow correction scratched where an Armada navigator would notice it. The altered bearing points away from the guarded quay and toward a warehouse cut.

actors.name: C08_01_RouteMarkB
actors.title: Ethan's second route mark
actors.body: A second deliberate error confirms the prison-navigation vessel's berth and a narrow boarding window between patrol turns.
